conditions.runtime: Dedicated server only; permission-2 operator explicitly selects one living target with /jemcombat start <target> <seconds>, 1-120 game seconds, at most 1024 stored observations.

change.summary: Opt-in bounded read-only observation of native combat rather than estimating accepted hits from requested damage or Forge damage-event amounts.

observations: LivingEntity.hurt entry requested amount, source and direct entity
LivingHurtEvent and LivingDamageEvent amounts/cancellation at LOWEST, explicitly not accepted damage
actual net health and absorption before/after each call
invulnerability ticks, death state, difficulty, tier, equipment SNBT and effects
outer-call net pool-loss rate per game second including idle capture time

modifiers.notes: Nested same-target observations are marked; aggregates use outer calls only. Head/return do not see rejection before super.hurt in Player/mod overrides, direct setHealth damage, or restoration within the call. Curios/capabilities, spell IDs and true cooldown timers are not captured. No test scenario, gear mutation, entity spawn, tier change or gameplay launch is performed.

rationale.purpose: Measure Laser Gatling, continuous spells and percentage-health attacks under realistic operator-selected loadouts without changing native damage acceptance or inventing observed DPS.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly requested targeted sandbox instrumentation in JEM Power System Revamp; Codex chose bounded selected-target read-only native hit observation.

introduced.summary: Added off-by-default selected-target dedicated-server combat capture.

history.summary: Inspected Forge47.4.10 mapped LivingEntity and Player bytecode; Player.hurt reaches LivingEntity.hurt while Player.actuallyHurt overrides the mitigation implementation. Observe entry/return around that dispatch, keeping event amounts separate from actual net pool changes.

notes: Permission 2 commands and capture have no integrated-singleplayer runtime ownership.
Output is one explicit target capture JSON under world/jem-combat-captures; no data is sent to clients or external services.
Unpaired HEAD/RETURN observations from canceled injections or exceptions invalidate the capture at tick END and suppress rates; the diagnostic never changes combat or guard state.
Standalone pure-Java regression checks cover nested de-duplication, absorption-only hits, true-return zero-damage calls, rejections, healing, invalid pools and tick-rate normalization.
unresolved: Runtime output has not been captured or promoted to measured evidence.
Class-specific overrides that never invoke super.hurt and direct health mutation remain outside this observation boundary.
Curios/capability state and native spell cooldown/IDs require separately verified owner adapters; inter-hit timing is not cooldown.
